Formalises the in-prose 'REVIEW (inferred)' convention (Graphify-borrow #1). 'review' = human must verify before treating as canon; 'inferred' = reasoned, lower urgency. ★ THE GATE CAUGHT A REAL DEFECT IN THIS FILE, AND IT IS WORTH RECORDING BECAUSE IT ANSWERS $decisionsForDave 7 IN App-shell-top-nav. `_validate_descender_clip.py` flagged `.sh-detail-head h1` — the truncating record title in the detail header — as a truncating label with no descender-safe override, which would clip the tail of a g, y, p or q in a record name at narrow widths. The repair is `text-box-edge:text text` on the two-part selector, and the computed edge was checked in a real browser rather than assumed (ds-005: trim specificity beats single-class overrides). NOTE WHAT THIS PROVES: shipping a page-scale shell inside knowledge/snippets/ meant an existing component gate read it and found something a screenshot would not have shown. That is the whole argument for the brief's proposed convention, and it earned itself in one build.

Visually the closest, and the one most likely to be mistaken for this. Progress-tracker shows a KNOWN, FINITE, FORWARD process with done/current/upcoming steps and a completion the user is travelling toward; it carries aria-current="step" and role="progressbar". Timeline has no current step, no upcoming, no completion and no total — it is open-ended and backward-looking.
